parsed.post: New best: 0.839791. The recent decrease in MATRIX_LR and increase in WEIGHT_DECAY seems to be working. I'll now test increasing the DEPTH to 8 to see if the increased capacity can be effectively trained within the 5-minute window with the current stabilized LR.
